note: Fictional rule set for the fictional SYNTH-01 wording. Used by tests and the dev examples.

rules.title: Room rent limit with proportionate deduction
rules.plain: Room rent is paid up to 1% of your sum insured per day. If you take a costlier room, the doctor's fees, nursing and operation theatre charges are also cut, in the same proportion as the room rent. Medicines, implants and tests are paid in full.

citation.quote: Room rent is payable up to 1% of the sum insured per day. If the insured person occupies a room with a higher daily rent, the room rent and the associated medical expenses shall be paid in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent.

rules.title: Cataract sub-limit
rules.plain: Cataract treatment is paid up to ₹40,000 per hospital stay, whatever the hospital charges.

citation.quote: Claims for cataract treatment are payable up to Rs 40,000 per hospitalisation.

rules.title: Initial 30-day waiting period
rules.plain: Nothing is paid for a hospital stay in the first 30 days of the policy, unless it is after an accident.

citation.quote: No claim is payable for any hospitalisation in the first 30 days from the policy start date, except hospitalisation following an accident.

rules.title: Specific waiting period
rules.plain: Cataract, hernia and joint replacement are not paid for until the policy is 2 years old.

citation.quote: Treatment of cataract, hernia and joint replacement is not payable until 24 months (730 days) from the policy start date.

rules.title: Pre-existing disease waiting period
rules.plain: A condition you declared when you bought the policy is not paid for until the policy is 3 years old.

citation.quote: Expenses for any pre-existing disease declared in the proposal are not payable until 36 months (1095 days) from the policy start date.

rules.title: Cosmetic surgery exclusion
rules.plain: Cosmetic treatment is not paid for. Reconstruction after an accident or burns is.

citation.quote: Cosmetic or aesthetic treatment is excluded, unless it is reconstruction following an accident or burns.

rules.title: Non-medical items
rules.plain: Non-medical items, such as attendant charges, toiletries, food for attendants and registration, are not paid for.

citation.quote: Non-medical items such as attendant charges, toiletries, food for attendants and registration charges are not payable.

rules.title: Senior citizen co-payment
rules.plain: If the patient is 61 or older on the day of admission, you pay 20% of every claim yourself.

citation.quote: If the insured person is aged 61 or above on the date of admission, each admissible claim is subject to a co-payment of 20% of the admissible amount.

rules.title: Room rent waiver rider
rules.plain: If you bought the room rent waiver rider, there is no room rent limit: any room is paid as billed.

citation.quote: Where the room rent waiver rider is purchased, clause 3.2 does not apply and room rent is payable as billed.
